terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using the Flocify platform. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please discontinue use immediately.

s1.title: Definitions
s1.body: In these Terms and Conditions: "Flocify", "we", "us", or "our" refers to PT Flocify Nusantara, the company operating this digital marketplace. "User", "you", or "your" refers to any registered buyer or seller accessing our platform. "Platform" refers to the Flocify website, APIs, and associated digital services. "Products" refers to the premium tuna and seafood products listed for sale. "Order" refers to any confirmed purchase request submitted through the Platform.

s2.title: Eligibility & Account
s2.body: You must be at least 18 years old and represent a legally registered business entity to use the Flocify platform as a buyer or seller. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account. Flocify reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

s3.title: Use of the Platform
s3.body: You agree to use the Flocify platform only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe the rights of others. Prohibited activities include: misrepresenting the origin, species, or quality of any seafood product; circumventing any security or access control measures; scraping or automated data collection without written permission; using the platform to conduct transactions that violate applicable export/import regulations; and engaging in any fraudulent or deceptive conduct.

s4.title: Orders & Pricing
s4.body: All product listings on Flocify display indicative prices per kilogram (IDR/kg). Prices are subject to confirmation by our operations team based on actual stock, catch date, and volume. An Order is considered confirmed only after Flocify issues a written order confirmation via email or WhatsApp. Minimum order quantities apply as stated on each product listing. Flocify reserves the right to reject or cancel any order at its discretion.

s5.title: Payment
s5.body: Payment is accepted via bank transfer to designated Flocify accounts. Full payment is required before shipment unless a credit arrangement has been pre-approved in writing. Invoices will be issued upon order confirmation. For international orders, payment must be made in USD or IDR as agreed; any bank charges or currency conversion fees are the buyer's responsibility. Flocify does not store payment card details on its systems.

s6.title: Delivery & Logistics
s6.body: Flocify coordinates cold-chain logistics from Maluku and other fishing regions to the buyer's specified delivery address. Estimated delivery timelines are provided at time of order confirmation and are subject to vessel schedules, weather conditions, and customs clearance for international shipments. Risk of loss passes to the buyer upon handover to the designated carrier. For export orders, the buyer is responsible for ensuring compliance with the destination country's import regulations.

s7.title: Product Quality & Returns
s7.body: All tuna and seafood products sold through Flocify are sourced from verified fishermen and undergo quality inspection before shipment. Products are graded (A+, A, B+) and temperature-logged throughout the supply chain. In the event of a product quality dispute, you must notify Flocify within 24 hours of delivery with photographic evidence. Flocify will review valid claims and may offer a replacement shipment or credit at its sole discretion. Returns of perishable products are not accepted unless a quality defect is confirmed.

s8.title: Traceability & Compliance
s8.body: Flocify is committed to legal and sustainable fishing practices. All products listed are sourced from fishermen and vessels operating in compliance with Indonesian fisheries law (UU No. 45/2009 and its amendments) and international conventions. Buyers are required to conduct their own due diligence to ensure compliance with applicable import and food safety regulations in their respective jurisdictions. Flocify provides catch certificates and vessel documentation upon request.

s9.title: Intellectual Property
s9.body: All content on the Flocify platform — including but not limited to logos, brand assets, product photography, data, and software — is the exclusive property of PT Flocify Nusantara or its licensors and is protected by Indonesian and international copyright law. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from any Flocify content without prior written permission.

s10.title: Limitation of Liability
s10.body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Flocify shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the platform or any products purchased through it. Our total liability in connection with any claim shall not exceed the value of the order giving rise to such claim. Flocify makes no warranties, express or implied, regarding the availability, accuracy, or reliability of the platform.

s11.title: Governing Law & Disputes
s11.body: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with these terms shall first be attempted to be resolved through good-faith negotiation. If negotiation fails, disputes shall be submitted to the Indonesian National Arbitration Body (BANI) in Jakarta for binding arbitration in accordance with its rules.

s12.title: Contact Us
s12.body: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us. We aim to respond to all legal inquiries within 3 business days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Flocify, your privacy is fundamental to the trust we build with our fishermen, buyers, and partners. This Privacy Policy explains how PT Flocify Nusantara collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our platform.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.body: When you register and use the Flocify platform, we collect: Account information (full name, email address, username, phone number, and company details); Order information (shipping address, order history, quantity, and product preferences); Communication records (emails, WhatsApp messages exchanged with our operations team); Usage data (IP address, browser type, pages visited, and session duration); and Device information collected automatically through standard web technologies.

s2.title: How We Use Your Data
s2.body: We use your personal data to: process and fulfill your orders and communicate delivery status; verify your identity and business registration; send order confirmations, invoices, and operational notifications; improve our platform's features and user experience; comply with Indonesian tax, trade, and fisheries regulations; detect and prevent fraudulent activity; and, with your consent, send updates about new products, market insights, or promotions.

s3.title: Data Sharing
s3.body: Flocify does not sell your personal data to third parties. We share your data only with: logistics partners and cold-chain carriers necessary to fulfill your order; payment processing banks for transaction verification; government authorities when required by Indonesian law (e.g., customs, fisheries ministry); and technology service providers (e.g., cloud hosting, analytics) who are contractually bound to protect your data. All third-party partners are required to handle your data in accordance with applicable privacy law.

s4.title: Data Security
s4.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including TLS encryption for data in transit, row-level database security (Supabase RLS), access controls limiting data access to authorized personnel only, and regular security audits. While we strive to protect your data, no internet transmission is 100% secure. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential.

s5.title: Cookies & Tracking
s5.body: Flocify uses essential session cookies necessary for the platform to function (e.g., authentication tokens). We also use analytics cookies to understand how users navigate the platform, helping us improve the experience. You can control cookie settings through your browser. Disabling essential cookies may impair platform functionality. We do not use third-party advertising tracking cookies.

s6.title: Data Retention
s6.body: We retain your account and order data for as long as your account is active or as required by Indonesian law (typically 5 years for commercial transaction records). Order and invoice data may be retained longer to comply with tax obligations. You may request deletion of your personal data at any time, subject to our legal retention obligations.

s7.title: Your Rights
s7.body: Under applicable Indonesian data protection regulations, you have the right to: access the personal data we hold about you; request correction of inaccurate data; request deletion of your data (subject to legal retention requirements); withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time; and lodge a complaint with the relevant Indonesian data protection authority. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the email below.

s8.title: Contact Us
s8.body: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact our data protection team. We aim to respond within 5 business days.
